skills.name: Malefic Bomb
skills.description:
Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the first enemy hit (can Crit).
Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and <font color='#404495'>(Void Projectile)</font> gain extra range for 3s, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.
skills.tips: This skill can shoot in a straight target. This is perfect if you want to slowly cut down your foe. But take note that you will need to use this skill wisely.

skills.name: Void Projectile
skills.description:
Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target enemy that explodes on hit, dealing 170<font color='#D58E1F'>( +65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to targets in the area and applying a <font color='#404495'>(Magic Mark)</font> on them for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a <font color='#404495'>(Magic Mark)</font>, she deals 100<font color='#D58E1F'>( +35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25s.
skills.tips: The Range of this skill will surely increase whenever the skill is being upgraded. This is totally useful when you want to slow your opponent's movement speed when pursuing it.

skills.name: Destruction Rush
skills.description:
Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500<font color='#D58E1F'>( +150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in a line.
<font color='#404495'>(Passive:)</font> The range of Layla's <font color='#404495'>(Void Projectile)</font> and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Her sight range is also slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.
skills.tips: The beams can go through walls or rocks. So this is useful if you are stealing your teammate's kills. Just joking. You can use this to reduce your foe's HP greatly. Whenever the skill is upgraded, its basic attack range or basic attack distance will be increased by 0.4%. Use this wisely.

skills.name: Malefic Gun
skills.description: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.
skills.tips: Keep a long distance from your foe if you want to beat your foes easily. This is quiet useful for her by the way.

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.des: Unique Passive - Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% Attack Speed for 2s.

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Great Dragon Spear
items.des: Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 15% for 7.5s. This effect has a 15s cooldown.

items.name: Rose Gold Meteor
items.des: Unique Passive - Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gain a 420-910 shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3s. This effect has a 60s cooldown.

builds.tips: You can see that she had two lifesteals, one strong and heavy armor, one item that improves her movement and attack speed, and two items that increases her crit chance and basic attack. This is the perfect build for layla. Close for Burst. Its up to you though.
